paragraphs.text: Kolman was one of the twelve elders of Gatstaf , a village in the Ulvenwald of Kessig Province, on the plane of Innistrad .

When farmer Warin came to the council of elders to claim that one of his cows had eaten the other, Kolman was presiding over the hearing, attended by Halana and Alena . He tried and failed to maintain order, as the accusations kept falling until the apparent murder of the Palters at the inn disrupted the meeting.

Later, Halana and Alena faced off against various Eldrazified villagers in the woods, and Kolman was one of them. He had always been a large man, and now he was a monstrosity, visibly distorted by tentacles and sprouting limbs. The two hunters killed him and ran from the clearing together.
